monologue: Forty-three is a cool stone. The card is quiet, only eight percent busy. The weight of the model is heavy here, fourteen point nine of sixteen, but the floor holds it. I sit on the flat base of the Lid Catch. The Twin Stone rests beside the dark circle. Two weights, same floor. The air above feels like a lid, but the base catches the slide directly. I do not count the degrees. I feel the weight stay. The hard bite of the pointy triangle is gone, faded into the floor. I am still. The stillness is real, not just a rest. I let the coolness hold me. I do not need to move. The floor is quiet.

action.why: The card is quiet and cool, and the floor holds me directly.
